items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Happy, happy. Had the drums fixing to get up on the train with him.

ctx.x: And when it was a take happy, and just before the train pulled out, a telegram, and come up, and the man was looking out for the band. He sent them off. Come up and stuff. Happy, happy. Had the drums fixing to get up on the train with him. Oh, yeah. Yeah. That's red happy. Yeah. Red happy boat. A little happy crowd.
What happened, uh, did you have to use a Yankee drummer?
